BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: What is sexual misconduct? ASSISTANT:

Sexual misconduct is any non-consensual or abusive behavior related to sexual conduct. It can include physical acts, verbal harassment, or non-verbal behavior. Examples of sexual misconduct can range from fondling, to rape, to unwanted sexual contact.
